name: Pixel
tagline: Crisp pixel-art illustrations in warm grays, with one orange touch.
description: Chunky pixel art for product sites and docs: objects drawn on a small grid, each with a one-cell warm outline, white tops and light fronts lit from the top-left, and a soft ground shadow. Orange marks one thing per drawing, and motion snaps whole cells. Every illustration ships in light and dark, built from a small drawing kit that agents can use to draw new ones in the same family.
